The '''Camblia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Southern Core]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> The system was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Camblian Order]]|system=Camblia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the group known as the [[Camblian Order]], which had a presence on the<ref name="Empire9">[[Empire 9|''Empire'' 9]]</ref> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC Eedoq">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Eedoq system/Legends|Eedoq system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eedoq]].<ref name="Empire9" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Camblia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
